title: Pointer to an Integer
description: Print the value and address of an integer using a pointer.
constraints: Read an integer, print its value and address using a pointer.
explanation: Both value and address of the integer are printed.

title: Swap Values Using Pointers
constraints: Read two integers, swap them using pointers, print the swapped values.

title: Pointer Arithmetic
description: Demonstrate pointer arithmetic with an array.
constraints: Read N, then N integers. Print each array element using pointer arithmetic.
explanation: Array elements are accessed via pointer arithmetic.

title: Dynamic Memory Allocation
description: Allocate and use a dynamic array.
constraints: Read N, allocate an array dynamically, print its elements.
explanation: Elements of the dynamic array are printed.

title: Pointer to a Function
description: Use a pointer to a function to call a simple function.
constraints: Declare a function, declare a pointer to it, use the pointer to call the function.
explanation: The function is called using a pointer.

title: Double Pointers (Pointer to Pointer)
description: Demonstrate use of a pointer to pointer.
constraints: Read an integer, use a double pointer to print its value.
explanation: Value is accessed and printed via pointer to pointer.

title: Dynamic 2D Array
description: Create, use, and delete a dynamic 2D array.
constraints: Read R and C, then R*C integers. Print the 2D array.
